name: @dsh-plugin/media-publish
description: Agent-driven browser publishing for self-media accounts: record a publish flow into a replayable recipe, and isolate accounts with their own proxy IP
comment: No runtime dependencies on purpose. The plugin is installed as a pnpm `link:` dependency, and pnpm does not install a linked package's own dependencies, so any bare import of a DSH package would fail to resolve from the profile. The two helpers that would otherwise come from @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools / @deepseek-ai/schemastery are reimplemented against the frozen registry contract in src/tool-kit.js. See docs/SPEC.md 搂5. The browser half under lib/ is hand-written in the shipped bundle shape, so it needs no build step; its only module requests are `react` and `react/jsx-runtime`, both of which the shell seeds in its frozen PLATFORM_MODULES table, so `dsh.client.external` is empty by design.
